mapper.select: SELECT c.* FROM cloud_credential c JOIN app_user u ON u.id=c.user_id AND u.status='ACTIVE' WHERE c.user_id=#{userId} AND c.provider=#{provider}
mapper.update: UPDATE cloud_credential SET mode=#{mode},encrypted_payload=#{encryptedPayload},version=#{version},updated_at=#{updatedAt} WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND provider=#{provider} AND version=#{version}-1
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cloud_credential WHERE encrypted_payload IS NOT NULL
